# Open Practice

> Twenty practical AI build paths, 250 activities and 39 free tools, free, with no sign-up and work you keep.

Open Practice is free, non-accredited AI training built around doing: 20 build paths, 250 activities and 39 tools, with offline downloads and no account required.

Owner: Coldcode SI Labs, Harare, Zimbabwe.
Storefront: https://openpractice.whop.site
Markdown: https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/index.md
Facts (JSON): https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json

## What it does

- Build paths: 20 paths from AI from zero, in plain words.
- Activities: 250 activities tied to real work.
- Tools directory: 39 free tools, with comparisons and a tool finder.
- Prompt library: Prompts that match the activities.
- Offline: Downloads that work without a connection.
- No account: Start without signing up.

## Prices

- Open Practice: free, one-off — https://whop.com/checkout/plan_59d90wjRRBXkW
- Open Practice Community: free, one-off — https://whop.com/checkout/plan_GcmHX2ZdYd3rx

## Questions

- [What is Open Practice?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): Open Practice is free, non-accredited AI training built around doing: 20 practical build paths, 250 activities and 39 free tools.
- [Is it really free?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): Yes. No account, no card, no sign-up form; the materials download for offline use and the work stays with the learner.
- [Do I get a certificate?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): No. Open Practice is non-accredited; what you keep is the work you built and the evidence around it.
- [Do I need a paid AI subscription?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): No. The activities are built around free tools in the directory.
- [Can I use it offline?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): Yes, the packs download and work without a connection.
- [Who is it for?](https://openpractice.open-practice.workers.dev/facts.json): People who have watched months of tutorials and still are not sure they could do it alone.
